style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, bright even lighting. The same art style in every episode. The background is always pure white.
avoid_en: any text, letters, numbers, logos, modern clothes, Roman armor, comic-book costumes, Japanese or Chinese clothing, nudity, bare chest, blood

chiron.desc_en: Chiron, the wise old centaur of Greek myth: the upper body of a calm gray-bearded man about 60 with long gray hair tied back and gentle deep-set eyes, joined at the waist to the body of a chestnut-brown horse with four horse legs and a dark tail; his human torso is fully covered by a long-sleeved undyed off-white wool chiton with a faded blue himation cloak over one shoulder (never bare-chested), a quiver on his back, no armor, no crown

heracles.desc_en: Heracles, the Greek hero, a very muscular young man about 30 with short curly black hair and a short black beard, wearing a knee-length dark brown wool chiton (chest covered) with a golden lion skin over his head and shoulders like a hood, holding a big wooden club, a bow and quiver on his back, leather sandals, Archaic Greek clothing

karkinos.desc_en: Karkinos, a giant crab of Greek myth drawn as a real animal: a dark red-brown crab about the size of a shield, with two big pincers, eight legs and small black eyes on stalks, no human features, wearing nothing

hera.desc_en: Hera, the queen of the Greek gods, a tall dignified woman about 40 with long black hair pinned up, cold proud eyes, a golden diadem, a long deep-blue peplos dress with a white veil, holding a scepter topped with a lotus, Archaic Greek clothing
